name: @kindgi/audit-events
description: Kindgi™ audit events contract. Types only: AuditEvent (the audit record — id, tenantId, projectId, kind, timestamp, actor, outcome, run / agent / flow / correlation ids, versioned payload), AuditEventFilter and AuditEventPage, AuditEventBinding (the caller-plugged append / query / purge interface) with its input and result shapes, and the AuditEventError union. No runtime code. A reference in-memory binding is @kindgi/audit-events-inmemory; durable bindings are provided by the Kindgi runtime.
